user.title: Sign in to Skylight
user.description:
1. [Open Skylight sign-in]({auth_url}) in a new tab.
2. Sign in with your Skylight email and password.
3. When the page finishes loading, look at the browser address bar. It contains `?code=...`.
4. Copy the value of `code` (or the whole URL, either works) and paste it below quickly: codes expire in about 30 seconds.

pick_frame.title: Choose your Skylight frame
pick_frame.description: This Skylight account has more than one frame. Pick one to set up now; you can add the others later.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Skylight API. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_auth: That code was rejected. Codes expire in about 30 seconds; open the link again to get a fresh one.
error.invalid_code: That does not look like a Skylight authorization code. Paste the value of `code=` from the address bar (or the whole URL).
error.no_frames: No Skylight frames were found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Skylight frame is already configured.
abort.all_frames_configured: Every frame on this account is already configured in Home Assistant.

init.title: Skylight Guard
init.description: A Skylight frame shows every event to anyone in the room. Choose which profiles Home Assistant may write events to. Leaving the allowlist empty denies every write.

data.show_private_titles: Show titles of private-marked events in the audit sensor
data.flag_uncategorized: Count events without a profile as rogue

error.default_not_allowed: The default write profile must also be in the allowlist.

caption.name: Caption
